verses.ar: وَكَانَ إِنْسَانٌ مَرِيضًا وَهُوَ لِعَازَرُ، مِنْ بَيْتِ عَنْيَا مِنْ قَرْيَةِ مَرْيَمَ وَمَرْثَا أُخْتِهَا.
verses.kjv: Now a certain [man] was sick, [named] Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.web: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ مَرْيَمُ، ٱلَّتِي كَانَ لِعَازَرُ أَخُوهَا مَرِيضًا، هِيَ ٱلَّتِي دَهَنَتِ ٱلرَّبَّ بِطِيبٍ، وَمَسَحَتْ رِجْلَيْهِ بِشَعْرِهَا.
verses.kjv: (It was [that] Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
verses.web: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلَتِ ٱلْأُخْتَانِ إِلَيْهِ قَائِلَتَيْنِ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، هُوَذَا ٱلَّذِي تُحِبُّهُ مَرِيضٌ».
verses.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
verses.web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ يَسُوعُ، قَالَ: «هَذَا ٱلْمَرَضُ لَيْسَ لِلْمَوْتِ، بَلْ لِأَجْلِ مَجْدِ ٱللهِ، لِيَتَمَجَّدَ ٱبْنُ ٱللهِ بِهِ».
verses.kjv: When Jesus heard [that], he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
verses.web: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَسُوعُ يُحِبُّ مَرْثَا وَأُخْتَهَا وَلِعَازَرَ.
verses.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
verses.web: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ أَنَّهُ مَرِيضٌ مَكَثَ حِينَئِذٍ فِي ٱلْمَوْضِعِ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ فِيهِ يَوْمَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
verses.web: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ لِتَلَامِيذِهِ: «لِنَذْهَبْ إِلَى ٱلْيَهُودِيَّةِ أَيْضًا».
verses.kjv: Then after that saith he to [his] disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
verses.web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُ ٱلتَّلَامِيذُ: «يَا مُعَلِّمُ، ٱلْآنَ كَانَ ٱلْيَهُودُ يَطْلُبُونَ أَنْ يَرْجُمُوكَ، وَتَذْهَبُ أَيْضًا إِلَى هُنَاكَ».
verses.kjv: [His] disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
verses.web: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

verses.ar: أَجَابَ يَسُوعُ: «أَلَيْسَتْ سَاعَاتُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ٱثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ؟ إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ يَمْشِي فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ لَا يَعْثُرُ لِأَنَّهُ يَنْظُرُ نُورَ هَذَا ٱلْعَالَمِ،
verses.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
verses.web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ يَمْشِي فِي ٱللَّيْلِ يَعْثُرُ، لِأَنَّ ٱلنُّورَ لَيْسَ فِيهِ».
verses.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
verses.web: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

verses.ar: قَالَ هَذَا، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ لَهُمْ: «لِعَازَرُ حَبِيبُنَا قَدْ نَامَ. لَكِنِّي أَذْهَبُ لِأُوقِظَهُ».
verses.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
verses.web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ تَلَامِيذُهُ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ نَامَ فَهُوَ يُشْفَى».
verses.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
verses.web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

verses.ar: وَكَانَ يَسُوعُ يَقُولُ عَنْ مَوْتِهِ، وَهُمْ ظَنُّوا أَنَّهُ يَقُولُ عَنْ رُقَادِ ٱلنَّوْمِ.
verses.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
verses.web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ يَسُوعُ حِينَئِذٍ عَلَانِيَةً: «لِعَازَرُ مَاتَ.
verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
verses.web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

verses.ar: وَأَنَا أَفْرَحُ لِأَجْلِكُمْ إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ هُنَاكَ، لِتُؤْمِنُوا. وَلَكِنْ لِنَذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ!».
verses.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
verses.web: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ تُومَا ٱلَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ ٱلتَّوْأَمُ لِلتَّلَامِيذِ رُفَقَائِهِ: «لِنَذْهَبْ نَحْنُ أَيْضًا لِكَيْ نَمُوتَ مَعَهُ!».
verses.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
verses.web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا أَتَى يَسُوعُ وَجَدَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ صَارَ لَهُ أَرْبَعَةُ أَيَّامٍ فِي ٱلْقَبْرِ.
verses.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had [lain] in the grave four days already.
verses.web: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ بَيْتُ عَنْيَا قَرِيبَةً مِنْ أُورُشَلِيمَ نَحْوَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ غَلْوَةً.
verses.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
verses.web: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ كَثِيرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْيَهُودِ قَدْ جَاءُوا إِلَى مَرْثَا وَمَرْيَمَ لِيُعَزُّوهُمَا عَنْ أَخِيهِمَا.
verses.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
verses.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ مَرْثَا أَنَّ يَسُوعَ آتٍ لَاقَتْهُ، وَأَمَّا مَرْيَمُ فَٱسْتَمَرَّتْ جَالِسَةً فِي ٱلْبَيْتِ.
verses.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat [still] in the house.
verses.web: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

verses.ar: فَقَالَتْ مَرْثَا لِيَسُوعَ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، لَوْ كُنْتَ هَهُنَا لَمْ يَمُتْ أَخِي!
verses.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

verses.ar: لَكِنِّي ٱلْآنَ أَيْضًا أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا تَطْلُبُ مِنَ ٱللهِ يُعْطِيكَ ٱللهُ إِيَّاهُ».
verses.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give [it] thee.
verses.web: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «سَيَقُومُ أَخُوكِ».
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

verses.ar: قَالَتْ لَهُ مَرْثَا: «أَنَا أَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ سَيَقُومُ فِي ٱلْقِيَامَةِ، فِي ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْأَخِيرِ».
verses.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
verses.web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «أَنَا هُوَ ٱلْقِيَامَةُ وَٱلْحَيَاةُ. مَنْ آمَنَ بِي وَلَوْ مَاتَ فَسَيَحْيَا،
verses.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ مَنْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَآمَنَ بِي فَلَنْ يَمُوتَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. أَتُؤْمِنِينَ بِهَذَا؟».
verses.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
verses.web: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

verses.ar: قَالَتْ لَهُ: «نَعَمْ يَا سَيِّدُ. أَنَا قَدْ آمَنْتُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱلْمَسِيحُ ٱبْنُ ٱللهِ، ٱلْآتِي إِلَى ٱلْعَالَمِ».
verses.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
verses.web: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا قَالَتْ هَذَا مَضَتْ وَدَعَتْ مَرْيَمَ أُخْتَهَا سِرًّا، قَائِلَةً: «ٱلْمُعَلِّمُ قَدْ حَضَرَ، وَهُوَ يَدْعُوكِ».
verses.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
verses.web: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

verses.ar: أَمَّا تِلْكَ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ قَامَتْ سَرِيعًا وَجَاءَتْ إِلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: As soon as she heard [that], she arose quickly, and came unto him.
verses.web: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَسُوعُ قَدْ جَاءَ إِلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ، بَلْ كَانَ فِي ٱلْمَكَانِ ٱلَّذِي لَاقَتْهُ فِيهِ مَرْثَا.
verses.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
verses.web: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ ٱلْيَهُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا مَعَهَا فِي ٱلْبَيْتِ يُعَزُّونَهَا، لَمَّا رَأَوْا مَرْيَمَ قَامَتْ عَاجِلًا وَخَرَجَتْ، تَبِعُوهَا قَائِلِينَ: «إِنَّهَا تَذْهَبُ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ لِتَبْكِيَ هُنَاكَ».
verses.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
verses.web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

verses.ar: فَمَرْيَمُ لَمَّا أَتَتْ إِلَى حَيْثُ كَانَ يَسُوعُ وَرَأَتْهُ، خَرَّتْ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ قَائِلَةً لَهُ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، لَوْ كُنْتَ هَهُنَا لَمْ يَمُتْ أَخِي!».
verses.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
verses.web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَآهَا يَسُوعُ تَبْكِي، وَٱلْيَهُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَاءُوا مَعَهَا يَبْكُونَ، ٱنْزَعَجَ بِٱلرُّوحِ وَٱضْطَرَبَ،
verses.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
verses.web: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

verses.ar: وَقَالَ: «أَيْنَ وَضَعْتُمُوهُ؟». قَالُوا لَهُ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، تَعَالَ وَٱنْظُرْ».
verses.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
verses.web: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

verses.ar: بَكَى يَسُوعُ.
verses.kjv: Jesus wept.
verses.web: Jesus wept.

verses.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْيَهُودُ: «ٱنْظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ يُحِبُّهُ!».
verses.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
verses.web: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

verses.ar: وَقَالَ بَعْضٌ مِنْهُمْ: «أَلَمْ يَقْدِرْ هَذَا ٱلَّذِي فَتَحَ عَيْنَيِ ٱلْأَعْمَى أَنْ يَجْعَلَ هَذَا أَيْضًا لَا يَمُوتُ؟».
verses.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
verses.web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

verses.ar: فَٱنْزَعَجَ يَسُوعُ أَيْضًا فِي نَفْسِهِ وَجَاءَ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ، وَكَانَ مَغَارَةً وَقَدْ وُضِعَ عَلَيْهِ حَجَرٌ.
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَسُوعُ: «ٱرْفَعُوا ٱلْحَجَرَ!». قَالَتْ لَهُ مَرْثَا، أُخْتُ ٱلْمَيْتِ: «يَا سَيِّدُ، قَدْ أَنْتَنَ لِأَنَّ لَهُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ».
verses.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been [dead] four days.
verses.web: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهَا يَسُوعُ: «أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكِ: إِنْ آمَنْتِ تَرَيْنَ مَجْدَ ٱللهِ؟».
verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
verses.web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

verses.ar: فَرَفَعُوا ٱلْحَجَرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ٱلْمَيْتُ مَوْضُوعًا، وَرَفَعَ يَسُوعُ عَيْنَيْهِ إِلَى فَوْقُ، وَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا ٱلْآبُ، أَشْكُرُكَ لِأَنَّكَ سَمِعْتَ لِي،
verses.kjv: Then they took away the stone [from the place] where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up [his] eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
verses.web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

verses.ar: وَأَنَا عَلِمْتُ أَنَّكَ فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ تَسْمَعُ لِي. وَلَكِنْ لِأَجْلِ هَذَا ٱلْجَمْعِ ٱلْوَاقِفِ قُلْتُ، لِيُؤْمِنُوا أَنَّكَ أَرْسَلْتَنِي».
verses.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said [it], that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
verses.web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

verses.ar: وَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا صَرَخَ بِصَوْتٍ عَظِيمٍ: «لِعَازَرُ، هَلُمَّ خَارِجًا!».
verses.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
verses.web: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

verses.ar: فَخَرَجَ ٱلْمَيْتُ وَيَدَاهُ وَرِجْلَاهُ مَرْبُوطَاتٌ بِأَقْمِطَةٍ، وَوَجْهُهُ مَلْفُوفٌ بِمِنْدِيلٍ. فَقَالَ لَهُمْ يَسُوعُ: «حُلُّوهُ وَدَعُوهُ يَذْهَبْ».
verses.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verses.web: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

verses.ar: فَكَثِيرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْيَهُودِ ٱلَّذِينَ جَاءُوا إِلَى مَرْيَمَ، وَنَظَرُوا مَا فَعَلَ يَسُوعُ، آمَنُوا بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
verses.web: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا قَوْمٌ مِنْهُمْ فَمَضَوْا إِلَى ٱلْفَرِّيسِيِّينَ وَقَالُوا لَهُمْ عَمَّا فَعَلَ يَسُوعُ.
verses.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
verses.web: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

verses.ar: فَجَمَعَ رُؤَسَاءُ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ وَٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ مَجْمَعًا وَقَالُوا: «مَاذَا نَصْنَعُ؟ فَإِنَّ هَذَا ٱلْإِنْسَانَ يَعْمَلُ آيَاتٍ كَثِيرَةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
verses.web: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

verses.ar: إِنْ تَرَكْنَاهُ هَكَذَا يُؤْمِنُ ٱلْجَمِيعُ بِهِ، فَيَأْتِي ٱلرُّومَانِيُّونَ وَيَأْخُذُونَ مَوْضِعَنَا وَأُمَّتَنَا».
verses.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all [men] will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
verses.web: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ وَاحِدٌ مِنْهُمْ، وَهُوَ قَيَافَا، كَانَ رَئِيسًا لِلْكَهَنَةِ فِي تِلْكَ ٱلسَّنَةِ: «أَنْتُمْ لَسْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَ شَيْئًا،
verses.kjv: And one of them, [named] Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
verses.web: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

verses.ar: وَلَا تُفَكِّرُونَ أَنَّهُ خَيْرٌ لَنَا أَنْ يَمُوتَ إِنْسَانٌ وَاحِدٌ عَنِ ٱلشَّعْبِ وَلَا تَهْلِكَ ٱلْأُمَّةُ كُلُّهَا!».
verses.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
verses.web: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

verses.ar: وَلَمْ يَقُلْ هَذَا مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، بَلْ إِذْ كَانَ رَئِيسًا لِلْكَهَنَةِ فِي تِلْكَ ٱلسَّنَةِ، تَنَبَّأَ أَنَّ يَسُوعَ مُزْمِعٌ أَنْ يَمُوتَ عَنِ ٱلْأُمَّةِ،
verses.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
verses.web: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

verses.ar: وَلَيْسَ عَنِ ٱلْأُمَّةِ فَقَطْ، بَلْ لِيَجْمَعَ أَبْنَاءَ ٱللهِ ٱلْمُتَفَرِّقِينَ إِلَى وَاحِدٍ.
verses.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
verses.web: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

verses.ar: فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ تَشَاوَرُوا لِيَقْتُلُوهُ.
verses.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
verses.web: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

verses.ar: فَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَسُوعُ أَيْضًا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ ٱلْيَهُودِ عَلَانِيَةً، بَلْ مَضَى مِنْ هُنَاكَ إِلَى ٱلْكُورَةِ ٱلْقَرِيبَةِ مِنَ ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ، إِلَى مَدِينَةٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أَفْرَايِمُ، وَمَكَثَ هُنَاكَ مَعَ تَلَامِيذِهِ.
verses.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
verses.web: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ فِصْحُ ٱلْيَهُودِ قَرِيبًا. فَصَعِدَ كَثِيرُونَ مِنَ ٱلْكُوَرِ إِلَى أُورُشَلِيمَ قَبْلَ ٱلْفِصْحِ لِيُطَهِّرُوا أَنْفُسَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
verses.web: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

verses.ar: فَكَانُوا يَطْلُبُونَ يَسُوعَ وَيَقُولُونَ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمْ، وَهُمْ وَاقِفُونَ فِي ٱلْهَيْكَلِ: «مَاذَا تَظُنُّونَ؟ هَلْ هُوَ لَا يَأْتِي إِلَى ٱلْعِيدِ؟».
verses.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
verses.web: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

verses.ar: وَكَانَ أَيْضًا رُؤَسَاءُ ٱلْكَهَنَةِ وَٱلْفَرِّيسِيُّونَ قَدْ أَصْدَرُوا أَمْرًا أَنَّهُ إِنْ عَرَفَ أَحَدٌ أَيْنَ هُوَ فَلْيَدُلَّ عَلَيْهِ، لِكَيْ يُمْسِكُوهُ.
verses.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew [it], that they might take him.
verses.web: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
